text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Following her heart and holding<n>nothing back, Ines
Fujin puts on a<n>brilliant performance at the
Japanese<n>Derby and claims the title of Derby
champion.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Although she can barely walk after<n>her fierce
performance, she musters<n>the energy to head over
to the stands<n>and respond to her supporters'
cheers.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
They chant her name over and over in<n>celebration
of her victory. Summoning<n>the last of her strength,
Ines Fujin<n>thanks the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And finally, after her winning concert...<n>she
collapses.
